**Planscherel Measure on Eq(2)**

*H. Ahmedov1 and I. H. Duru2,1*

17 pp, 6 sections.

**Abstract.** Following the construction of the invariant integral and the scalar product for the quantum Euclidean group Eq(2), we obtained the full matrix elements of its unitary irreducible representations from SUq(2) by contraction and then derived the Planscherel measure. July 1998 1E–mail : hagi@fge1.gursey.gov.tr and duru@fge1.gursey.gov.tr 1

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Invariant Integral on $E_q(2)$; 3 Scalar Product on $E_q(2)$; 4 Matrix Elements of the Irreducible Represent; 5 Planscherel Measure on $E_q(2)$
